name: Darling Pet
source:
In the middle of your everyday life, you rescued animals from a suspicious building. But the animals…turned into four men! From the animals to the dangerous neighborhood that follows them. Can you keep your peaceful daily life?

[Edited from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.darlingpet]Google Play[/url]]
